name: Cricket
description: Inter-departmental T20 and 15-over floodlit tournaments played on turf pitches with full batting, bowling, and fielding telemetry.
rulesSummary: 11 players per side, powerplay in overs 1-4, maximum 3 overs per bowler.

name: Football
description: 90-minute 11-a-side collegiate league and knockout cup contested on the main floodlit campus grass pitch.
rulesSummary: Two 35-minute halves, up to 5 rolling substitutions, FIFA collegiate fair-play rules.

name: Basketball
description: Fast-paced 5-on-5 indoor court championship featuring departmental divisions and shot-clock officiating.
rulesSummary: Four 10-minute quarters, 24-second shot clock, FIBA collegiate rules.

name: Badminton
description: Singles and doubles wooden-court championships judged to 21-point rally scoring under indoor spotlights.
rulesSummary: BWF 21-point rally system, deuce up to 30 points, feather shuttles for knockouts.

name: Volleyball
description: 6-a-side tactical court matches emphasizing net blocks, spike efficiency, and rotational defense.
rulesSummary: 25-point sets (15-point decider), libero defense allowed, 2 timeouts per set.

name: Athletics
description: 100m, 400m, 1500m track sprints, 4x100m relays, and long jump events timed on the 400m synthetic oval.
rulesSummary: Electronic photo-finish timing, two false-start disqualification, standard relay zones.

name: Table Tennis
description: High-reflex singles and mixed doubles fixtures held in the Recreation Pavilion on ITTF-grade tables.
rulesSummary: ITTF 11-point scoring, alternate two-service rotation, 3-star competition balls.

name: Chess
description: Swiss-system rapid and blitz campus championships tracking ELO ratings, tie-breaks, and departmental points.
rulesSummary: FIDE Rapid rules, 15 minutes + 10-second increment, touch-move strictly enforced.
